extension.description: Find the Claude Code slash commands of your project, your team's plugins and Claude Code itself: search them by what you want to do, see what they are for, copy or run them.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: In Restricted Mode SlashDeck does not start Claude Code: it lists only the command, skill and plugin files, without the built-in commands.
welcome.loading: Looking for the slash commands of Claude Code...
welcome.error:
The slash commands could not be listed.
[Refresh List](command:slashdeck.refresh)
[Show Log](command:slashdeck.showLog)
config.claudePath: Path of the Claude Code executable (`claude`). Empty: the `SLASHDECK_CLAUDE_PATH` environment variable, then `claude` on the `PATH`. Machine setting: it cannot be set by a workspace.
config.refreshOnStartup: Refresh the list in the background when VS Code starts. The saved list is shown at once in any case; without a saved list the list is always refreshed.
config.focusClaudeCodeAfterCopy: After **Copy**, move the cursor to the input of the Claude Code panel, so that you only have to paste. Only when the official Claude Code extension provides that command and no terminal running Claude Code was detected.
